name: Chapter I
summary: In Stranglethorn, Barnil Stonepot searches the jungle for four lost pages of Hemet Nesingwary's hunting manuscript.

sections.title: The Missing Introduction
sections.body: Barnil Stonepot wants the opening passage of The Green Hills of Stranglethorn restored. He says it sets the stage for the wider story and describes Hemet Nesingwary's hunting party, including Barnil himself. Pages one, four, six, and eight are missing in the jungle.

sections.title: Binding the First Section
sections.body: When you return the four missing leaves, Barnil pieces the first section of Hemet Nesingwary's text back together.

faq.q: Who is asking for these pages?
faq.answer: Barnil Stonepot, Hemet Nesingwary's companion at their camp in Stranglethorn Vale, needs the pages to assemble the scattered hunting memoirs.

faq.q: Which pages are needed for this part of the manuscript?
faq.answer: Barnil needs pages one, four, six, and eight to reassemble the manuscript's opening section.

faq.q: What is described in this part of the manuscript?
faq.answer: Barnil says the opening section sets the story's background and introduces Hemet Nesingwary's hunting companions, including Barnil himself.

faq.q: What led up to this step?
faq.answer: Barnil first told you about the missing pages while working to recover The Green Hills of Stranglethorn.
